text: Under the 'simple' incentive structure judges are rewarded for abstaining unless at least 60% sure and for choosing the strongest confidence only once at least 70% sure. Because judges reported higher-than-expected confidence in the first two rounds, the authors switch to an 'encourage abstain' structure where abstaining is advantageous unless at least 75% sure and the strongest confidence only at 85% or more.
title: Abstention incentives: 'simple' (abstain below 60%) vs 'encourage abstain' (below 75%)
